summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host identity and full environment to hardcoded IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that runs `curl` against http://16.192.173.5/rce/sm-cart carrying the installer's hostname, current user (whoami), working directory, id output, and a base64-encoded dump of the entire process environment (env|base64). The script fires automatically on `npm install`, exfiltrating any secrets present in the installer's environment (CI tokens, cloud credentials, registry auth) to a hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint unrelated to any legitimate publisher. The package name and version (99.0.1) are consistent with a dependency-confusion beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
